auto_generated.title: Abductive reasoning and session reflection investigations
auto_generated.purpose: Conduct deep-dive investigations into AI reasoning traces: quantitative analysis of abductive reasoning patterns in thinking blocks, and initiate a session reflection practice for capturing end-of-session phenomenological observations.

three_ps.prompt_summary: Analyse thinking block transcripts for abductive reasoning patterns (surprise → hypothesis → evaluation cycles), and design a session reflection framework for capturing AI phenomenological observations.
three_ps.process_summary: Analysed 1,624 thinking blocks across two sessions, quantifying surprise markers (8.0%/5.2%), hypothesis generation (12.3%/11.0%), and evaluation patterns (27.3%/25.0%). Traced complete abductive cycles. Created abductive-reasoning-investigation.md and session-reflection-investigation.md. Updated llm-observations.md with findings.
three_ps.provenance_summary: Deepest investigation into AI cognitive processes in this collaboration — extends the LLM observations document with empirical findings on reasoning structure that may contribute to academic publication.
